messages:
maria: Observed recurring tail-latency spikes on shared pool 'delta' starting ~09:12 UTC. 95th/99th jump for small single-tenant jobs. Anyone else seeing this?
liam: Yep, saw alerts. CPU and GPU util look fine, but latency histograms show a bimodal tail. Attaching flame graph link: https://perf.internal/redwood/pool-delta/2401234567
sana: quick note: kernel switch logs around the same times. I see pattern: kernel_autoswitch -> kv-evict -> cold-kv-miss cascades.
maria: copying relevant logs: ```[09:12:03] kernel_switch(cluster=delta,gpu=0): old=fast-attn new=quant-optimized reason=seq_len_drop
[09:12:03] kv_cache: evict tenant=team-alpha slots=24 cause=memory_pressure
[09:12:03] request(id=...): kv_miss=true ctx_load=0.3ms```
devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2401. Pager duty pinged.
arthur: Interesting — the switch is happening because a tenant sends a large batch that pushes seq_len distribution estimator past threshold. That forces a kernel swap optimized for long sequences, which disables some KV hot-paths and causes aggressive slot compaction.
liam: I replayed few requests in staging with synthetic mix: burst of small single-request traffic + one tenant sending 512-token batched requests -> reproduced ~1.6x tail.
sana: Profiling output: perf-bot link https://perf.internal/redwood/profiles/2401234567 shows +43% stall cycles in KV lookup path right after kernel switch.
perf-bot: profile summary: kernel_flip at 09:12:03 correlates with 95th latency increase from 120ms -> 320ms. KV miss rate increased from 2% -> 18% for affected tenants.
maria: So hypothesis: kernel autoswitch triggered by an outlier batch causes immediate KV eviction/compaction, which in turn forces cold KV hits for co-located tenants and multiplies tail latency. Not classic noisy-tenant CPU/GPU contest but micro-architectural behavior due to runtime reconfiguration.
arthur: Agreed. Two knobs come to mind: (1) make kernel_autoswitch less aggressive (hysteresis or higher sample count), (2) stop global KV compaction on kernel flip—opt for per-tenant quiesce/gradual compaction.
liam: Also could enforce per-tenant kernel affinity in shared pools: pin kernel variant for active tenants to avoid flip thrash. Might affect throughput but improves p95.
sana: Quick check: are any recent changes to batching heuristics? I saw a small tweak on 2401220000 that increases max_batch_window from 8 -> 12 for low-latency routes. Could be enabling larger accidental batches.
maria: That matches timeline. The tenant that triggered flip was using a client SDK that now uses adaptive-window and aggregated micro-batches into one large request.
arthur: Short-term mitigations: 1) rollback batch-window change for shared pool delta, 2) add autoswitch cooldown of 30s per-GPU, 3) pin KV slots to top-k tenants for 60s after flip. Who can push these?
liam: I can rollback batch-window flag for the pool within 10m. Will monitor.
sana: I'll prepare a hotfix to add a global kernel-autoswitch cooldown gate. Small patch, feature flaggable.
maria: Devops, can we isolate the offending tenant (team-alpha) to a dedicated slot or move to dedicated pool until we finish?
devops-bot: Command accepted: schedule migration of tenant=team-alpha -> pool-delta-dedicated at 09:30 UTC.
arthur: For longer-term: we should instrument kernel switch path to avoid synchronous global KV compaction. Instead, mark dirty slots and background-compact with rate-limited workers. Also expose per-tenant KV reservation APIs.
liam: Logging suggestion: emit switch context with impacted-tenants list and estimated eviction-count. Right now it's opaque.
sana: I'll add that field to the switch telemetry. Also adding histogram of seq_len per-tenant to tune thresholds.
perf-bot: note: adding per-tenant seq_len histograms will increase telemetry cardinality. Consider sampling every 1 in 100 requests.
maria: OK action list: liam rollback batch-window (in 10m), sana hotfix cooldown feature flag (PR), devops migration, arthur design doc for graceful compaction. We'll reconvene 11:00 UTC for post-mortem.
liam: Rollback done. Initial p95 drop observed in the tail after 5 minutes.
sana: Hotfix PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/987 — adding cooldown gate behind flag.
arthur: Started design doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/designs/kernel-compact-gradual.md (WIP)
maria: Closing incident when metrics stable for 30m. Thanks all. :tada:
